unit_boundary: ONE original product presentation contribution in the existing FieldJourney. Projector, browser/native controls, UI and CI support are not extra laboratory/source/portfolio units or human studies.
question: Can the same confirmed person and actual equipped rig remain visibly accountable to actual encounter position, announced threat and accepted action consequences, while reaching the position threshold never manufactures completion before remaining encounter beats?
selection_disagreement: Scientific analysis initially preferred a new finite field-aid decision. That would require new core mechanics and original numeric policies because preserved consumable HP/SP columns are empty. The coordinated decision instead addresses an actual product truth/identity dependency in the existing journey without changing Session gameplay.
baseline: Existing Intake/Memory/Forge/Crossing owners and field custody already operate. Current crossing requires both surviving the real remaining beats and reaching required position; survey victory is not full journey completion. No new package, owner recreation, source-effect grant, save migration or gameplay action is intended.
rival_explanations: An actor may be only decoration or may depict a different identity, rig, accent or position than the confirmed owner.
A position marker can reach the far-side threshold while the actual encounter remains active; treating threshold as completion fabricates a result.
A rendered threat or response may use stale/derived client facts rather than actual accepted owner state and actual damage, resolve, movement or refusal.
Passing deterministic controls may be misrepresented as human recognition, readability, enjoyment or balance.
planned_execution: Run the actual existing C# host in Chromium using real form/buttons and real command/state endpoints; no state fixture, owner replacement or direct HP/progression injection.
Confirm one visible identity, acquire and allocate actual fittings/rigs, then enter actual survey/crossing encounters.
Compare visible identity, class, accent, rig, position/required, active/terminal phase and announced BOLT/PULSE against actual owner/projector observations.
Check accepted response deltas against consecutive actual snapshots: movement, HP, resolve and beat. Refused commands cannot produce accepted response consequences.
Exercise an actual threshold-reached-but-active state and actual survey victory without full completion, then actual final completion or loss.
Retain an actual losing policy and actual late workshop/refusal boundary; no return, delivery, heal, refund or reopened workshop is inferred from the board.

Run separate isolated actual renderer mutants for false completion and false actor identity/rig/position where exact source seams permit; require the intended fidelity assertion to detect them rather than counting startup/environment failure.
Capture and inspect actual images. Bind executable/presentation/protocol/dependency inputs before and after execution and stop owned hosts.
limits: Actual browser and deterministic C# controls overlap outcomes; they are not participants, population observations, independent scientific studies or measured effort.
This original destination projector/presentation does not implement historical consumables, full character creation, full equipment/animation pipeline or approved class/world canon.
No source Ruby/RGSS/RMXP, human recognition/comprehension/accessibility, physical device, balance, commercial clearance or production ownership claim follows.
Linux/.NET/browser execution is not Unity Editor, licensed module, ordinary-user Windows or Steam delivery.
A displayed accepted response is historical observation, not a new gameplay clock, predictive authority, delivery or return receipt.

brain_influence.SCI-013: Prespecify false-identity, false-threshold-completion and stale-response rivals.
brain_influence.SCI-014: Operationalize correspondence to actual owners without substituting it for human identity recognition or enjoyment.
brain_influence.SCI-076: Select actual owner/browser comparison and renderer mutants for presentation truth, retaining participant assessment as a separate method.
brain_influence.SCI-077: Retain actual losing/refused outcomes and avoid duplicated controls becoming independent studies.
